title: Judge by hours to a verified outcome
statement: Judge material by the time students need to reach a verified outcome, not by time spent, which measures presence rather than learning.
detail: The delivery platform's quality bar for apps counts efficiency as fewer hours to reach the same verified outcome (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0026-evaluating-apps.qmd`). Its effort metric exists because tracking time measures presence, not learning, and tracking accuracy ignores how much work was done, so it combines effort with proof (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0030-xp-system.qmd`).

evidence.quote: | **Efficiency**                 | Fewer hours to reach the same verified outcome     |
track **time** (which measures presence, not learning) or track **accuracy** (which ignores how much work was done).
